meta.title: Side chat
meta.description: Right-click a text selection in a chat to get two actions: "Quote in current chat" inserts a Markdown blockquote into the current composer without sending, and "Ask in side chat" forks the conversation into a real child Session and opens its Chat in a tab on the right sidebar. The child Session stays in the session list and inherits the parent's history as visible reference context. The selected text is prefilled into the child draft as a blockquote plus a visible boundary note, but nothing is sent automatically: only pressing Enter starts a model request, which may include tool calls. Closing the tab does not delete the child Session, and disabling the bundle removes both right-click entries. Unlike Codex, there is no hidden developer boundary and no ephemeral thread: inherited history is visible in the child and the child is a normal Session. v2 batch A adds a /side command, a right-Sidebar guide capsule and home page, a recent-side-chats list that reopens closed tabs side-by-side, a nesting-depth limit and a visible truncation note. Batch B moves the create operation into the Host half: the Web UI and an agent tool call the same Host service method, the developer boundary becomes a hidden system-prompt section, and the Host row is named side-chat-v2 with a Config schema. Changing Host code needs remove_bundle + install_bundle (or a DSH restart). Developed against DSH 0.2.2-rc.5.
